concept: Events in order along a hairline rail, each a dot with its time, title and story; where you are reads by the dot shape.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Timeline with coloured icon circles on a thick vertical line
default_to_avoid.kind: timeline, activity log, history, order tracking
default_to_avoid.why_not: coloured circles carry the state by hue and a thick line is louder than the events; Pane uses solid, ringed and hollow dots on a hairline

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: past dots are solid, the current one is ringed and future ones are hollow, so the state reads by shape

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: every dot is the loud solid or an outline in the text tone, so no state needs a hue

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the rail is a hairline in the divider tone, the same line that separates rows across the system

options: A dots on a hairline rail
variants.picked: A dots on a hairline rail
variants.reason: A carries every state by shape (P6) without hue (P1). B brings hues. C stacks panes inside panes.

root.why: the events stack as an ordered list so their order is read as well as seen

item.why: each event is a two-column row, the dot column and the text column, with room under it

dot.why: a past event is a solid dot in the loud solid, aligned with the first line of text

current.why: the current event is ringed and in dark gives off a faint light, so it reads as now

upcoming.why: a future event is a hollow dot and its title drops to the secondary tone

body.why: the time, title and story stack tightly so each event reads as one block

time.why: the time is at caption size in tabular figures and the secondary tone above the title

title.why: the title is semibold at body size because it says what happened

description.why: the story is secondary at label size so it supports the title without competing

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable
